title: Artifact Analysis Scanner
description: The user operates a holographic analysis scanner on a damaged space helmet. The InterpolationTest model serves as a rotating diagnostic array orbiting the helmet, and the user must click scan points on the helmet to reveal damage layers, toggle the diagnostic array's animation modes, and adjust an X-ray intensity slider to peel back surface materials.
prompt:
Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 (via importmap from cdn.jsdelivr.net) that implements an interactive 3D artifact scanner scene. Load both GLB models using GLTFLoader.

SCENE SETUP: Place the DamagedHelmet centered at origin, scaled to fill roughly 60% of the viewport. Position the InterpolationTest model scaled down to 0.4 and orbiting the helmet in a circular path at radius 3, rotating continuously around the Y-axis. Use a dark background (0x0a0a1a) with a subtle grid floor using GridHelper. Add ambient light (intensity 0.3) and two directional lights (cool blue from above-left, warm orange from below-right) to create a sci-fi scanning aesthetic.

CAMERA: Use PerspectiveCamera at position (0, 1.5, 5) with OrbitControls. Limit polar angle so the user cannot go below the floor.

INTERACTIONS (5 steps total):
1. SCAN POINTS: Use Raycaster on click to detect hits on the DamagedHelmet. On first click, place a glowing green ring (TorusGeometry) at the hit point and display an HTML overlay label showing 'Scan Point 1 Acquired'.
2. SECOND SCAN: On second helmet click, place a second scan ring (red) at that point and show 'Scan Point 2 Acquired'.
3. ANIMATION TOGGLE: Add a button labeled 'Toggle Diagnostic Array'. When clicked, play or pause all AnimationClips from the InterpolationTest model using AnimationMixer. Show the animation state in a status badge.
4. X-RAY SLIDER: Add an HTML range slider (0 to 1). As the user drags it, lerp the DamagedHelmet's material opacity from 1.0 to 0.2, making it semi-transparent. Traverse all helmet meshes and set transparent=true, adjusting opacity accordingly.
5. CAPTURE BUTTON: Add a 'Capture Analysis' button that, when clicked, briefly flashes the screen white using a full-screen overlay div with CSS transition, then displays a summary panel listing the two scan coordinates and current X-ray level.

Use an AnimationMixer in the render loop for the InterpolationTest animations. Style all UI controls with a dark semi-transparent panel fixed to the bottom of the screen. Ensure all interactive elements have clear visual feedback.
